verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Chargebacks API that retrieves details of the chargebacks on an account, and test mode can simulate chargebacks. Together these give some read-only visibility into chargebacks. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to submit or respond to a dispute with structured evidence, or to track a dispute through stages to resolution. missing for 10: dispute response or evidence-submission capability, documented dispute lifecycle statuses and outcome tracking, dashboard workflow for finance-ops, independent corroboration.
